evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are vulnerable to visual prompt injection, in which an adversarially perturbed image forces the model to respond with the attacker's chosen content, such as malicious tool calls, website links, or advertisements, sometimes regardless of the user's question.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: To identify the anomalous value subspace, we compare the statistics of each input's attention-head outputs with those of clean images and extract the directions along which the input deviates the most.
